'''Pho Ph'eah''' was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], that served as the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] for the four-[[Limb/Legends|armed]] [[Pho Ph'eahian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Located far from its [[Star/Legends|star]], Pho Ph'eah relied on its heavy natural geothermal activity to provide heat to its native lifeforms. Pho Ph'eahians were naturally adept with technology, and turned Pho Ph'eah into a hub of technological development in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after contact with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Description==
Located along the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Kalamith sector/Legends|Kalamith sector]],<ref name="eao" /> Pho Ph'eah was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] of diverse terrains and active geothermal forces. The planet's natural geothermal activity kept the world&mdash;which was located far from its [[Star/Legends|star]]&mdash;warm despite the relatively little solar heat it received,<ref name="hsc" /> especially when it was in the outer reaches of its [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. Pho Ph'eah's [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] had an abundance of small animals and vegetation.<ref name="eas" />

==History==
Civilization on Pho Ph'eah evolved with the native [[Pho Ph'eahian]]s, who over [[Time/Legends|time]] managed to develop nuclear fusion and limited spaceflight on their own.<ref name="hsc" /> Once held by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]],<ref name="TEA" /> Pho Phe'ah eventually attracted the attention of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="hsc" /> sometime between [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000]] and [[3000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> and quickly welcomed the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] government's advanced technology to Pho Ph'eah.<ref name="hsc" /> The natives swiftly turned advanced technology into their culture's calling card, as they developed and exported new [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]], weapons and other devices.<ref name="eas" /> Pho Ph'eah, along with that entire stretch of the Hydian Way, fell within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|Weird guys. Really, really weird.|Han Solo, about the Pho Ph'eahians|<ref name="eas" />}}
The sole [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that called Pho Ph'eah home was the four-[[Limb/Legends|armed]] Pho Ph'eahians, who evolved from mountain-dwelling hunters who used their powerful limbs to climb Pho Ph'eah's heights.<ref name="hsc" /> Pho Ph'eahians lived off a high-tech system of agriculture, developing many new methods of food production on Pho Ph'eah's large farms.<ref name="eas" /> Naturally adept with technology, Pho Ph'eahians often stood out in the wider galaxy due to their appearance, and were known for their affable natures and senses of humor.<ref name="hsc" /> Although they did not often leave their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], they were in high demand as [[Technician/Legends|mechanics]] and [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] offworld.<ref name="eas" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pho Ph'eah was first mentioned in ''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]'', a novel written by [[Brian Daley]] and released in [[1979]].<ref name="hsr">''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]''</ref> Further information on the world was given in later reference books, such as [[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]<ref name="eas" /> and ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="TEA" />
